meta.author: OpenMedia
meta.summary: Hides SoundClick's sign-up banner, app badge and sale rails; blur cover art; optional pitch sections
meta.notes:
Checked 2026-11-13, logged out, real Chrome (headless) with iPhone UA 390x844 and desktop UA on the SoundClick home page, DOM captured after 7 seconds. Fixtures `real.html` and `desktop-real.html` are sanitised excerpts of that DOM (text stripped, only ancestors the selectors need, `data-keep` on main content, Log in link and player).

LIVE (querySelectorAll on the rendered home page, same counts on phone and desktop): `#homepage_v6_header_hero_nag_wrapper` 1, `#installPWAImage` 1 (inside a plain span), `#hp_seasonal_blackfriday` 2 (the id is used twice), `.item_picture` 110 (cover art is a CSS background-image on a div, so blur works and there is no img), `.hp_songlist_picture` 20, `.hp_sectionsWrapper.hp_forListeners` 5, `#scrollToTop` 1. The pop-up box `#popupBox_wrapper` exists but is empty until an interaction, so it is not touched.

Choices: Cover artwork Show/Blur. No Hide choice, because the picture holds the play button in song lists.

NOT verified: the cookie banner and ad rules (the three original options did not match anything on the logged-out home page in this region); artist, track and store pages; the lazy-loaded Top promoter and Top sellers sections (empty in the captured DOM); logged-in pages. Class names are readable site classes, no hashes.
